title: Ontology Playground: Free Tool to Learn & Design Ontologies for Microsoft Fabric IQ
description:
Ontology Playground is a free, open-source web app from Microsoft for learning about ontologies and designing your own. Explore a catalogue of pre-built ontologies, use the visual editor, and export as RDF/XML. Perfect for Fabric IQ users. More like this → gittrend.io
